split_rule: retain original source train exactly; source validation first floor(n/2) selection; next257 excluded; remaining tail descriptive test
alpha_selection: 4 expanding prequential blocks, first 1/5 initial fit
history_selection: source-validation RMSE; within 0.1% of minimum prefer shorter L
A_selection: trainOOF-only fit, minimum online cold-start validation RMSE; within 0.1% prefer shorter H, then stronger alpha

probe.fit: base OOF / second-stage prequential final residuals

base_test_fit: source train only, same model as validation; no validation refit
A_test_fit: train base OOF residuals only; same model as validation
acf: segmented globally centered biased FFT estimator, never cross segments or gaps; E sums lags1..k
test_use: only after all three recipes + probes frozen
